description:
Turn your voice into polished text.

Ultra-fast AI powered dictation that understands what you want to say and how you want to say it. Instantly turn speech into perfect emails, crisp notes, clear messages, professional communication, and more.
## Features
- All-time stats view with X share card
- Updated S1-Mini model with tone control
- Cohere Transcribe is now marked as stable
- Word-by-word playback highlighting in History
- S1 announcement modal
## Improvements
- Significant performance boost for local Whisper models
- Vocabulary support for local Whisper models
- Updated application icon
- Smoother multipart model download progress updates
## Fixes
- Elevenlabs Scribe real-time "no voice found" fix
- Super mode parsing fix to remove errant `` tags in responses
